''See also: [[Deepstriders Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Deepstriders are massive, blue-scaled sea serpents characterized by [[dragon]]-like mouths and enormous gullets. These leviathans possess immense physical power, including the ability to shake the [[water]] with their growls and heal themselves, though their regenerative abilities can slow down under certain conditions. Historically, these creatures were so formidable that they prevented long-distance maritime travel. They are known to migrate in large numbers, which can pose a significant threat to vessels on the ocean. While they typically favor quick, overwhelming attacks to devour prey, they can become impatient during prolonged combat. Some Deepstriders may also be linked to individuals through a form of power or connection, as seen when their strength serves another person.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Deepstriders are a type of [[Kameira]] of the sea characterized as massive, blue-scaled leviathans with mouths resembling those of [[dragons]]. These sea serpents possess solid blue eyes and can command the motion of [[water]], producing growls deep enough to shake the surrounding sea. While juvenile versions appear as blue-scaled [[Kameira]], the mature creatures were once so formidable that they rendered long-distance sea travel impossible. [[Alchemists]] even claim to offer the fortitude of these beasts, which are noted for a preference for overwhelming force and an impatience for combat.}}
